# Chanpreet Kaur

> Software engineer at Pathlock, Punjab Engineering College graduate, and builder of developer tools and web experiences.

This is the official portfolio of Chanpreet Kaur. The site is a single-page portfolio; section links below point to the corresponding content.

## Profile

- Current role: Software Engineer at Pathlock, since October 2025.
- Education: Bachelor of Technology in Electrical Engineering, Punjab Engineering College (December 2021 to September 2025).
- Location: Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab, India.
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/chanpreet-kaur-a6974922b/

## Selected projects

- Codex Rollout Insights: local-first VS Code extension for inspecting Codex session usage and repository trends. Source: https://github.com/Chanpreetk03/Codex-Credits-Overview
- Open Authentication & Security Research Platform: interactive OAuth, JWT, and SAML security learning labs. Source: https://github.com/Chanpreetk03/Open-Authentication-Security-Research-Platform
- AI-DJ: crowd-reactive music experience using local audience signals and realtime room state. Source: https://github.com/Chanpreetk03/AI-DJ
